# NBC
> Watch full episodes of current and classic NBC shows, browse schedules, clips, previews, and official network content.

NBC.com is the official site for the NBC television network, covering scripted and unscripted series, late night, news, sports-adjacent programming pages, schedules, episode streaming, clips, photos, and show-specific extras.

## Shows
- [NBC Shows](https://www.nbc.com/shows): Browse current and past NBC series, franchises, and entertainment programming.
- [Happy's Place](https://www.nbc.com/happys-place): Official show hub with episodes, clips, cast, and news.
- [Dateline](https://www.nbc.com/dateline): Official page for Dateline episodes, clips, and program information.
- [St. Denis Medical](https://www.nbc.com/st-denis-medical): Official comedy series page with episodes, videos, and cast details.
- [The Voice](https://www.nbc.com/the-voice): Official competition series hub with episodes, artists, and coaches.
- [Saturday Night Live](https://www.nbc.com/saturday-night-live): Official SNL page with sketches, episodes, and cast content.
- [The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon](https://www.nbc.com/the-tonight-show): Official late-night show page with monologues, interviews, and clips.
- [Late Night with Seth Meyers](https://www.nbc.com/late-night-with-seth-meyers): Official late-night series page with segments, interviews, and full episodes.

## Episodes & Video
- [Latest Episodes](https://www.nbc.com/latest-episodes): Stream the newest available NBC episodes across current series.
- [Full Episodes](https://www.nbc.com/full-episodes): Watch full episodes from NBC shows available online.
- [Video](https://www.nbc.com/video): Browse clips, highlights, previews, and featured NBC video content.
- [Trending Now](https://www.nbc.com/trending): See currently featured and popular shows, clips, and episodes.
- [Schedule](https://www.nbc.com/schedule): View NBC's broadcast schedule by date and time.
- [Live](https://www.nbc.com/live): Access NBC live stream information and supported viewing options.

## News & Reality
- [Dateline](https://www.nbc.com/dateline): Long-running newsmagazine series with full episodes and featured cases.
- [The Voice](https://www.nbc.com/the-voice): Singing competition series with performances, recaps, and contestant content.
- [America's Got Talent](https://www.nbc.com/americas-got-talent): Talent competition hub with auditions, performances, and episodes.
- [American Ninja Warrior](https://www.nbc.com/american-ninja-warrior): Competition series page with runs, clips, and episode content.
- [Weakest Link](https://www.nbc.com/weakest-link): Official quiz show page with episodes, clips, and host information.
- [Deal or No Deal Island](https://www.nbc.com/deal-or-no-deal-island): Reality competition page with episodes, videos, and cast details.

## Late Night & Comedy
- [Saturday Night Live](https://www.nbc.com/saturday-night-live): Sketch comedy institution with episodes, clips, and recurring characters.
- [The Tonight Show Starring Jimmy Fallon](https://www.nbc.com/the-tonight-show): Late-night entertainment with celebrity interviews, games, and music performances.
- [Late Night with Seth Meyers](https://www.nbc.com/late-night-with-seth-meyers): Late-night commentary and interview show with recurring segments.
- [Lopez vs Lopez](https://www.nbc.com/lopez-vs-lopez): Comedy series page with episodes, clips, and cast information.
- [Night Court](https://www.nbc.com/night-court): Official sitcom page with episodes, videos, and character details.

## Drama & Scripted Series
- [Chicago Fire](https://www.nbc.com/chicago-fire): Firehouse drama page with episodes, cast, and franchise content.
- [Chicago Med](https://www.nbc.com/chicago-med): Medical drama hub with full episodes, clips, and cast details.
- [Chicago P.D.](https://www.nbc.com/chicago-pd): Police drama page with episodes, videos, and character information.
- [Law & Order](https://www.nbc.com/law-and-order): Official series page with episodes, clips, and cast updates.
- [Law & Order: SVU](https://www.nbc.com/law-and-order-special-victims-unit): Franchise page with episodes, clips, and show information.
- [Found](https://www.nbc.com/found): Drama series page with episodes, videos, and cast details.
- [The Irrational](https://www.nbc.com/the-irrational): Official drama page with episodes, previews, and cast information.

## Classics & Library
- [Classic Shows](https://www.nbc.com/classic-tv): Explore classic NBC series and archival program pages.
- [Days of our Lives](https://www.nbc.com/days-of-our-lives): Legacy daytime soap page with show information and related content.
- [Murder, She Wrote](https://www.nbc.com/murder-she-wrote): Classic series page with available episodes and clips.
- [Little House on the Prairie](https://www.nbc.com/little-house-on-the-prairie): Classic drama page with episodes and show details.
- [Saved by the Bell](https://www.nbc.com/saved-by-the-bell): Official page for the classic teen comedy franchise.
- [The A-Team](https://www.nbc.com/the-a-team): Classic action series page with episodes and related content.

## Games, Apps & Extras
- [NBC App](https://www.nbc.com/apps): Learn about NBC apps and supported streaming experiences.
- [NBC Insider](https://www.nbc.com/nbc-insider): Editorial features, recaps, interviews, and behind-the-scenes coverage.
- [Photos](https://www.nbc.com/photos): Browse galleries from NBC shows, casts, and events.
- [Cast Bios](https://www.nbc.com/cast): Explore cast and personality pages across NBC programming.
- [Global Casting](https://www.nbc.com/global/pages/casting): Official casting and audition opportunities for eligible NBC shows.

## Help & Account
- [Help Center](https://help.nbc.com/): Support articles for streaming, apps, sign-in, and troubleshooting.
- [Profile](https://www.nbc.com/profile): Manage NBC account settings and profile information.
- [Activate Your Device](https://www.nbc.com/activate): Link a TV provider or device for supported NBC viewing.
- [TV Provider Sign In](https://www.nbc.com/tv-provider): Sign in with a participating television provider for access.
- [Accessibility](https://www.nbc.com/accessibility): Accessibility information and support resources for NBC digital properties.

## Corporate & Legal
- [About NBC](https://www.nbc.com/about): Overview of the NBC network and brand information.
- [Terms of Use](https://www.nbc.com/terms): Terms governing use of NBC websites and services.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.nbc.com/privacy): Privacy practices for NBC digital products and services.
- [Your Privacy Choices](https://www.nbc.com/privacy#your-privacy-choices): Privacy choice information and opt-out details.
- [Closed Captioning](https://www.nbc.com/closed-captioning): Information about captioning support and compliance.
- [Contact Us](https://www.nbc.com/contact-us): Contact options and support pathways for NBC users.
